title: Senior Project Management Lead
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


End\-to\-end ownership of one or more technology projects or releases. Plan and effectively manage all aspects of the project or release including cost, schedule, scope, quality and project resources following the appropriate methodologies.**Key Responsibilities**

* Major areas of accountability: Manage Project Life Cycle \~\~ Manage Project Resources \~\~ Develop Project \~\~ Reporting \~\~ Manage Expectations \~\~ Financial Accountability Indirect Expense $1\-5MM

Accountable for project communications, milestone tracking, resource planning, financials, risk assessment and contingency planning and escalation and resolution of critical issues to project sponsor/owners.
* 25% Provide leadership to project resources in a manner that ensures timely delivery on commitments/tasks in support of broader project deliverables. Align and lead cross\-organizational resources to ensure successful delivery of the project. Identify project resource requirements including on\-shore, off\-shore, employee and contractor resources and work with plan sponsors to ensure adequately skilled resources are available to deliver on project commitments.
* 20% Develop the overall project vision, approach, objectives and key deliverables; identify/track key measures of success. Ensure project tracking and status are maintained appropriately. Provide regular status reporting on plan progress, and ensure all company standards are followed. Ensure appropriate testing and quality reviews are conducted and receive sign\-off.
* 15% Create and manage the overall project readiness plan and communicate impacts to appropriate stakeholders. Lead and participate in regular post\-implementation reviews and present project metrics to assist with evaluation of project quality. Provide regular status reporting for assigned releases. Log, track and escalate high\-priority project issues that may impact ability to deliver a quality project according to plan.
* 15% Work effectively with business partners, vendors and staff to develop the project agenda and ensure agreement/adoption of project objectives/deliverables by affected constituencies. Provide proactive project communication to project owner. Work to identify cross\-organizational interdependencies and ensure appropriate integration to project plan. Effectively manage client expectations and resource requirements to ensure ownership and success.

* Focus: Business or related field; or equivalent work experience 10 \- 12 years' experience
* 10\+ years successful track record of delivering projects that meet business objectives as well as time, budget and quality guidelines.
* Solid understanding of business functional areas and management issues as well as the IT organizations systems and capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to deal with ambiguity and to effectively manage within it.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills including with executive level presentations. Strong analytic and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience managing project plans, timelines, test plans, resources and budgets.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Successful experience driving cross\-functional and cross\-organizational teams to meet project objectives. Expert skills in project management methodologies, processes and industry standard tools.
* Proven ability to work effectively with on\-shore and off\-shore employee and contract resources.
* Ability to formally present project related information in a clear, concise and persuasive manner.
* Ability to relate well at all levels of the organization, building rapport and maintaining collaborative relationships.

**In\-Office Collaboration**  

We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. title: PMO Analyst
description:
**About Lab49**



Lab49 is an award\-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology solutions and products for the world's leading financial institutions. Founded in 2002, Lab49 combines strategy, design, and technology expertise to deliver transformative outcomes for investment banks, asset managers, exchanges, and other capital markets participants.


**Role Overview**



Lab49 is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented PMO Analyst to support the successful delivery of strategic technology and transformation initiatives. The PMO Analyst will play a key role in driving project governance, integrated planning, reporting, risk management, resource coordination, and delivery controls across complex programs.



This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical skills, and the ability to provide transparency into project performance, dependencies, risks, and milestones while supporting delivery teams and leadership.



“**Success in this role means building a PMO that improves delivery outcomes, not simply administering governance activities”**


**Key Responsibilities**


**PMO Capability Building and Operating Model**


* Help design, establish, and mature a scalable PMO operating model covering governance, integrated planning, reporting, financial controls, resource management, risk management, and delivery assurance.
* Establish common delivery metrics and dashboards that give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, quality, and financial performance.
* Create reusable playbooks for discovery, mobilization, execution, release readiness, stabilization, and program closure.


**End\-to\-End Delivery Management**


* Support delivery from initial discovery and mobilization through planning, execution, release, stabilization, and closure.
* Maintain an end\-to\-end view across business, product, design, architecture, engineering, quality engineering, cybersecurity, compliance, and operations.
* Identify sequencing issues, delivery gaps, conflicting priorities, and cross\-team dependencies before they affect critical milestones.
* Drive ownership of actions and decisions, ensuring unresolved items are escalated with clear impact assessments and recommended options.
* Conduct delivery health checks, provide an independent evidence\-based view of status, and support recovery planning for at\-risk workstreams.
* Coordinate distributed teams and stakeholders across regions, functions, and partner organizations.

  


**AI\-Enabled Delivery and PMO**
* Use approved AI capabilities to improve the speed and quality of planning, reporting, meeting synthesis, dependency analysis, knowledge retrieval, and management communications.
* Ensure AI use complies with firm’s confidentiality, data\-protection, information\-security, and responsible\-use requirements.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PMO activities such as status consolidation, action tracking, document classification, and governance\-pack preparation.

  


**Governance and Executive Communication**  


* Prepare concise executive updates that clearly distinguish progress, risks, decisions required, implications, and recommended actions.
* Maintain accurate records of decisions, commitments, actions, and escalations.
* Prepare and maintain governance materials, status reports, steering committee packs, and executive dashboards.
* Monitor project progress against agreed milestones and provide delivery traceability and reporting.

  


**Integrated Planning, Risks, and Dependencies**  


* Own or coordinate integrated planning across multiple workstreams and delivery organizations.
* Establish dependency\-management practices that identify upstream and downstream impacts across product, technology, operations, and third parties.
* Facilitate RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management and ensure timely escalation of delivery risks and blockers.

  


**Financial, Commercial, and Resource Management**


* Support program budgeting, forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance analysis.
* Maintain visibility into team capacity, onboarding, allocation, role requirements, and forward demand.
* Connect resource plans with delivery milestones, critical skills, and workstream priorities.
* Support commercial tracking across statements of work, deliverables, milestones, change requests, and client commitments.
* Identify potential scope, timeline, or cost impacts early and support structured change\-control discussions.
* Provide forward\-looking views of capacity gaps and delivery constraints rather than relying only on retrospective reporting.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7 years of experience in PMO, project governance, delivery management, program controls, or related technology\-delivery roles.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning PMO workstreams and building or improving delivery\-governance practices within complex technology programs.
* Experience with RAID management, integrated planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders in a fast\-paced consulting environment.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting technology delivery programs within financial services, capital markets, banking, or fintech organizations.
* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience with financial tracking, resource planning, and executive reporting.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certifications.


**What You'll Bring**


* Strong attention to detail and execution excellence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A collaborative mindset with a focus on delivery outcomes.
* Data\-driven decision\-making and reporting capabilities.


**Information Security Responsibilities**


* Comply with all Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies, standards, and procedures.
* Protect confidential, client, and company information in accordance with Lab49 and ION security requirements.
* Promptly report security incidents, risks, or policy violations.
* Participate in mandatory security awareness and compliance training.
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory, contractual, and information security obligations.

title: Project Manager – Infrastructure | Innovation Labs & Makerspaces
description:
We are looking for a **Project Manager – Innovation Labs \& Infrastructure** to manage the end\-to\-end execution and setup of Innovation Labs, Makerspaces, STEM/STEAM Labs and technology\-enabled learning spaces across schools, colleges and institutional clients.

The candidate will be responsible for converting approved solution designs and project requirements into fully functional Innovation Labs by coordinating civil works, interiors, electrical, IT/networking, furniture, technology installation, vendors and site teams. The role requires strong project management, site execution, vendor coordination and client\-handling skills, along with the ability to manage multiple projects across different locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the end\-to\-end execution of Innovation Lab, Makerspace, STEM/STEAM Lab and technology\-enabled infrastructure projects.
* Understand approved project scope, layouts, BOQs, specifications and customer requirements before starting execution.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, execution schedules and milestone trackers and ensure timely completion.
* Conduct or coordinate site surveys to assess civil, interior, electrical, IT, networking, furniture and technology requirements.
* Coordinate civil and interior execution including flooring, painting, false ceiling, partitions, electrical work, lighting, furniture, storage, branding and lab\-specific infrastructure.
* Coordinate the installation and commissioning of computers, interactive displays, networking equipment, AV systems, robotics equipment, 3D printers, IoT devices, electronics and other lab technologies.
* Coordinate with architects, civil contractors, interior vendors, electricians, fabricators, IT teams and technology vendors throughout project execution.
* Manage vendors and contractors, monitor their performance and ensure adherence to agreed timelines, specifications, quality and scope.
* Review BOQs, measurements, material specifications and project requirements and coordinate with Procurement for timely availability of materials and equipment.
* Track project costs and ensure execution remains within the approved budget.
* Identify project risks, site constraints, dependencies and potential delays and take corrective action proactively.
* Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, workmanship, quality and adherence to approved designs.
* Ensure all civil, interior, electrical, IT and installation activities meet defined quality and safety standards.
* Coordinate with school and institutional representatives, facility teams, IT teams and management throughout the implementation phase.
* Act as the primary project execution contact for customers and provide regular updates on project progress, timelines and pending activities.
* Manage scope changes, additional requirements and execution\-related issues in coordination with internal teams and obtain necessary approvals.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, snag identification and closure before final project handover.
* Prepare project completion reports, installation checklists, asset lists, warranty documents, snag reports and other project documentation.
* Ensure complete and timely handover of the Innovation Lab to the customer and relevant internal teams.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously across different cities and ensure effective coordination of local vendors and site teams.
* Work closely with Pre\-Sales, Sales, Product, Curriculum, Procurement, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Provide execution feasibility inputs during the pre\-sales stage and highlight potential site, infrastructure, costing and implementation challenges.
* Provide feedback to the Pre\-Sales and Product teams based on project execution experience to improve future lab designs and solutions.
* Develop and standardize project execution checklists, site survey formats, installation processes and handover procedures.
* Travel extensively across India for site surveys, project execution, inspections, vendor coordination, customer meetings and project handovers.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Project Management or a related field.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in project execution, infrastructure, interior fit\-outs, civil works, commercial projects, educational infrastructure or lab setup.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end site execution projects with multiple vendors and contractors.
* Experience in Innovation Labs, STEM Labs, Robotics Labs, Makerspaces, Computer Labs, Educational Infrastructure or similar technology\-enabled spaces will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of civil, interior, electrical and IT infrastructure coordination.
* Experience in vendor management, contractor management, material coordination and project costing.
* Ability to understand floor plans, layouts, BOQs, measurements and technical specifications.
* Strong project planning, scheduling, execution and documentation skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and project management tools.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a hands\-on project execution professional who can take ownership of an Innovation Lab project from site survey through final handover. The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple contractors and vendors, coordinating civil, interior, electrical, IT and technology\-related activities, resolving site\-level issues and ensuring that projects are delivered on time and as per the approved design and scope.

The candidate should have strong ownership and problem\-solving abilities and should be capable of independently handling challenges such as site delays, vendor issues, material shortages, design changes, technical problems and customer escalations.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Timely completion of projects
* Adherence to approved project budgets
* Quality of project execution
* Vendor and contractor performance
* Timely closure of project snags
* Customer satisfaction during project implementation
* Effective material and cost management
* Successful project handover
* Reduction in project delays, rework and execution issues

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in project execution, infrastructure, interior fit\-outs or lab setup?
* Have you independently managed end\-to\-end projects involving civil, interior, electrical, IT or technology installation?
* Have you managed multiple vendors and contractors at customer sites?
* Have you worked on Innovation Labs, STEM Labs, Robotics Labs, Makerspaces, Computer Labs or similar projects?
* Are you comfortable travelling extensively across India for site visits and project execution?

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

title: Principal Program Manager
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Job Description: Project Manager (T4\)**

**Position:** Principal Program Manager— Level T4  

**Function:** Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development**. You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multi\-team coordination:** Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* **Customer project ownership:** Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* **High\-stakes project leadership:** Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* **Structured planning:** Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* **Innovation facilitation:** Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including **AI\-assisted project management** (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* **Status reporting:** Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* **Team collaboration:** Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.

**Required Profile**

* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* **Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus** — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
* **PMP certification (Project Management Professional) is a strong plus** — it demonstrates mastery of globally recognized PM standards and a commitment to the discipline.

**What We Value**


You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Senior Project Manager HVDC
description:
The Senior Project Manager – HVDC is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects from contract award through commissioning and closeout. This role has full accountability for project performance across safety, quality, schedule, cost, risk, and customer satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager coordinates multidisciplinary teams including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial, and contract management functions to ensure successful project delivery in line with company objectives and contractual commitments and will report to the Project Director.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Project Leadership and Execution


* Lead with team end\-to\-end execution of HVDC projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with contract requirements, budget, schedule, and quality standards.
* Partner with Project Director to establish project execution strategy, governance, and delivery plans.
* Drive project performance across all phases including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between project scope, execution methodology, and customer expectations.
* Manage internal and external project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide leadership to cross\-functional and geographically dispersed project teams.

2\. Commercial and Financial Management


* Along with Project Director take ownership of project P\&L, cost control, margin protection, cash flow, and financial forecasting.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contingencies, and billing milestones.
* Identify and manage changes in scope, claims, variation orders, and contractual entitlements.
* Ensure robust contract/commercial management in cooperation with finance, commercial, and contract management teams.
* Drive opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency.

3\. Schedule and Resource Management


* Support to develop and maintain integrated project schedules and key milestone plans.
* Support \& ensure appropriate allocation of project resources across engineering, supply chain, site execution, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor schedule progress and implement recovery plans when needed.
* Coordinate with functional managers to secure the required competencies and capacities for successful project delivery.

4\. Risk and Opportunity Management


* Lead identification, assessment, and mitigation of project risks and opportunities.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure timely implementation of mitigation actions.
* Anticipate project execution challenges related to technology, interfaces, supply chain, construction, grid connection, and regulatory requirements.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and propose practical solutions.

5\. Customer and Stakeholder Management


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of satisfaction and trust.
* Lead customer meetings, project reviews, progress reporting, and executive\-level communications.
* Manage interfaces with consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, utilities, consultants, and regulatory authorities as applicable.

6\. Contract and Claims Management


* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
* Support interpretation of contract terms, management of obligations, and administration of key notices.
* Lead or support preparation and negotiation of claims, extensions of time, and change requests.
* Work closely with legal and contract management teams to protect company interests.

7\. Quality, Safety, and Compliance


* Promote and enforce a strong culture of **EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety)** across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer specifications, industry regulations, and applicable standards.
* Drive quality assurance and quality control throughout project execution.
* Ensure project lessons learned are captured and applied.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering,** or related discipline.
* Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Project Management certification such as **PMP, IPMA, or equivalent** is preferred.

### **Experience**


* **15\+ years** of experience in project management, with significant experience in Large Infrastructure projects in the field of Transmission, Generation or O\&G. Experience in **HVDC, FACTS technologies** will be an added advantage**.**
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large, complex, multidisciplinary projects of \> $100 M.
* Must have experience of working on global contracts (in multiple geographies) and hands on experience of partnering \& working with global teams from various countries and cultures.
* Strong experience in managing customer contracts, project financials, risks, and claims.
* Experience in international project environments and matrix organizations preferred.
* Experience with utility, transmission system operator (TSO), or grid projects is highly desirable.

### **Required Skills**


* Understanding of **HVDC systems**, power transmission projects, and large infrastructure delivery.
* Excellent project management capabilities across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Strong technical, commercial and contractual acumen.
* Leadership skills with the ability to manage large cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with project planning, reporting, and financial management tools.
* Familiarity with EPC contract models and consortium project execution.
* Ability to manage multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong presentation and executive reporting skills.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Project Manager SAP Business One (Functional)
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager – SAP Business One (Functional)** to lead and manage end\-to\-end SAP Business One implementation and delivery projects. The candidate will be responsible for project planning, client and stakeholder management, functional requirement analysis, team coordination, risk management, and successful project delivery within agreed timelines, scope, and budget.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on knowledge of **SAP Business One modules, business processes, configuration, and implementation methodologies**, along with proven project management experience.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Project Planning \& Execution**

* Plan and manage end\-to\-end SAP Business One implementation projects.
* Define project scope, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and resource requirements.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely delivery within approved scope and budget.
* Coordinate project activities across functional, technical, and business teams.

**2\. Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Understand business requirements and manage client expectations.
* Conduct regular project status meetings and provide progress reports.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of client concerns.

**3\. SAP Business One Functional Management**

* Lead functional requirement gathering and business process discussions.
* Understand and map business requirements to SAP Business One functionalities.
* Provide functional guidance on SAP Business One modules, configuration, integration, and processes.
* Coordinate with functional consultants and technical developers for solution design and implementation.
* Review functional specifications and ensure solutions meet business requirements.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Coordination**

* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising SAP Business One functional consultants, developers, business analysts, testers, and other project resources.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance and deliverables.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among project teams.

**5\. Risk, Issue \& Change Management**

* Identify and proactively manage project risks, dependencies, and issues.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans to address project challenges.
* Manage scope changes through appropriate change\-control processes.
* Ensure project activities remain aligned with agreed scope, timelines, and quality standards.

**6\. Testing \& Quality Assurance**

* Coordinate functional testing, integration testing, UAT, and defect resolution.
* Review test plans and ensure adequate validation of SAP Business One functionality.
* Ensure the implemented solution meets approved business requirements and quality standards.

**7\. Documentation, Training \& Support**

* Ensure preparation and maintenance of project documentation, including:
* Business/Functional Requirement Documents
* Functional Specifications
* Project Plans
* Test Plans and UAT Documentation
* User Manuals and Training Materials
* Coordinate end\-user training and knowledge transfer.
* Support the transition from implementation to post\-go\-live support.

**8\. Project Closure**

* Ensure successful go\-live and project handover to the support/operations team.
* Conduct project closure reviews and document lessons learned.
* Ensure all project deliverables and documentation are completed and formally closed.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* **Minimum 7 years of experience** in SAP Business One Functional implementation/project management.
* Strong understanding of **SAP Business One architecture, modules, functionality, and configuration**.
* Proven experience managing **end\-to\-end SAP Business One implementation projects**.
* Good understanding of business processes such as **Finance, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, CRM, and related ERP processes**.

Pay: Up to ₹150,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Role Overview**



The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake\-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging **Snowflake Cortex** to enable AI\-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.

* Handle structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).


**2\. Data Transformation (ELT)**


* Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).

* Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.

**6\. Data Quality \& Validation**

**7\. Security \& Governance**
